Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding voter registration and informational activities at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voter registration and informational activitiesat institutions of higher education; and adding a new section tochapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Institutions of higher education shall: (1) In accordance with RCW 29A.08.310, put in place a prompt andlink to the secretary of state's voter registration web site; (2) Make voter registration forms available in places of prominencewithin the premises of each campus; (3) In consultation with the secretary of state, student programs,and the student government association, or its equivalent, develop andimplement policies regarding distribution of voter registration formsto students at the beginning of each term and in campus housingfacilities; and (4) Collaborate with student programs and the student governmentassociation, or its equivalent, to conduct nonpartisan voterinformation activities, which may include voter registration, candidate p. 1 SSB 6698debates, and issue forums. Responsibility for proposing suchactivities shall reside with the student government association, or itsequivalent.
